high_level_description: This image is a promotional poster for the movie "BlackBerry," directed by Matt Johnson. The poster features two main actors, Jay Baruchel and Glenn Howerton, prominently displayed at the top with their names written above them. The central part of the poster showcases a grid pattern that overlays the image of the two actors. This grid creates a visual effect where the faces of multiple individuals are integrated into the background, giving the impression of a crowd or a collective image.
